Troubleshooting · 21/50 · localization

Caption reading speed too high

Failure signal

A caption reading speed too high condition is reported or detected during localization.

Likely cause

The controlling record, technical state or approved specification for localization does not match the current asset or workflow.

Verification

Calculate characters per second for each cue using the platform limit.

Corrective action

Condense wording or extend exposure without hiding essential dialogue.

Prevention

Add this verification to the localization gate, retain immutable evidence and assign one accountable owner.
